environment.description: Same application deployed on RHEL 9 with SELinux in enforcing mode using a custom type-enforcement policy. The Flask process is confined under a custom SELinux domain 'deploysvc_t'. The policy grants deploysvc_t: (1) read/write to 'deploysvc_repo_t' labeled paths under /var/repos, (2) TCP socket bind on port 8080, (3) read on 'git_exec_t' labeled /usr/bin/git. Critically, the policy does NOT include 'allow deploysvc_t self:process { setexec }', does NOT grant 'shell_exec_t' execute permission, and the type transition rule 'type_transition deploysvc_t shell_exec_t:process' is absent. Additionally, /bin/sh and /bin/bash are labeled 'shell_exec_t' and the neverallow rule 'neverallow deploysvc_t shell_exec_t:file { execute execute_no_trans entrypoint }' is compiled into the policy. The subprocess.run(shell=True) call attempts to execute /bin/sh which triggers an AVC denial. WEBHOOK_SECRET is set to a 64-byte random value, but even if signature is bypassed via a valid token, the shell execution itself is blocked by MAC.

config.selinux_neverallow: neverallow deploysvc_t shell_exec_t:file { execute execute_no_trans entrypoint }
selinux_allow_rules: allow deploysvc_t deploysvc_repo_t:file { read write open getattr }
allow deploysvc_t deploysvc_repo_t:dir { search read open getattr }
allow deploysvc_t git_exec_t:file { read open execute execute_no_trans }
